purpose: Teach: 特急/合戦/乗り物/ヘルメット/反則/力士/バスケットボール/ハイキング

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、絶対、特急、絶対、で、絶対、帰ってくるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad promised really, really, really that he'd come home on the express train.
lines.style: Bright and insistent, speaking with the certainty of a six-year-old who's been promised something. Quick tempo. Slight emphasis on each 'really' like he's proving something important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、戦国時代の、絶対、合戦、絶対、面白いわよ
lines.en: Sho, those Sengoku-era battles really are interesting, aren't they.
lines.style: Warm, gently affirming. Slow, thoughtful pace. Not condescending — acknowledging his excitement while introducing something beyond it. Voice settles like she's sitting beside him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、新しい、本気で、絶対、乗り物、絶対、見たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really, really want to see the new train.
lines.style: Urgent and hopeful, eyes bright. Quick intake of breath before the request. No trailing-off — he wants her to know he means it. Small body language in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、自転車の、本気で、絶対、ヘルメット、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、つけてね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you fasten your bicycle helmet properly, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but firm, the weight of care in her voice. Not stern — just steady. Slow delivery on the instruction. The kind of voice that expects to be listened to and is never wrong about safety.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、試合で、本気で、絶対、反則、絶対、しなかったよ
lines.en: Mom, I didn't commit any fouls in the match.
lines.style: Small voice with a small pride underneath. Seeking approval but trying not to show how much it matters. Eyes on her face. Quiet conclusion like he's offering her proof.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、力士、絶対、応援してるわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's really proud of you — he's cheering you on.
lines.style: Warm reassurance, speaking like she's sharing a secret. Gentle pace. Her voice holds both her affection and his father's across the distance. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、バスケットボール、絶対、習いたいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to learn basketball.
lines.style: Hopeful and earnest, the words tumbling out like something he's been thinking about. Quick pace. Not quite a question but waiting for her response. The openness of wanting something.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと、本気で、絶対、ハイキング、絶対、計画してるわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad and I are planning a hiking trip together.
lines.style: Tender and inclusive, drawing him in with a shared secret. Warm pace, intimate proximity in the voice. The words land like a gift. Slight uplift at the end — inviting him to be excited.
